name: Curse Satan
description: A cursed demon blade wreathed in hellfire. Curse Satan corrupts the battlefield itself, poisoning the opponent's stamina and sapping their will to fight while growing stronger with each passing round.

ability.name: Hellfire Corruption
ability.description: Curse Satan calls down a pillar of hellfire: silence the enemy for 1 turn, apply a Corruption DoT (25 dmg for 4 turns), reduce enemy's ATK by 30 for 3 turns, and grant a 60 HP shield. The corruption cannot be cleansed.

special_move.name: Hellfire Stomp
special_move.description: Curse Satan slams down with the weight of a demon god — a single devastating impact that corrupts everything it touches!
flavour_texts: 😈 **Hellfire Stomp** — the demon's heel falls and the arena cracks under the cursed weight!
